div.l: As hoot he was and lecherous / as any sparowe Prologꝰus
Wᵗith scalled browes / blak and pyled berd
Of his vysage / children were a ferd
Ther nas quyk syluer / lytarge ne bronston
Boras Ceruce / ne oyle of tartre noon
Ne onyment / that wolde clense or byte
That him myht helpyn / of the welkys white
Ne of the knobbys sittyng on his chekys
Wel loved he garlek onyoıı̄uns and lekys
And for to drynke strong wyn̄ reed as blood
Thanne wold he speke / and crye as he were wood
And whan that he wel Dronken hadde / the wyn
Thanne wold he spekyn / no word but latyn
A fewe termes hadde he / too or thre
That he hadde lerned / out of som decre
No wondir is / he herd it alday
And eek ye knowen wel / that a Iay
Can clepe watte / as wel as the pope
But who so cowde / in other thinge him grope
Than hadde he spent / al his philosophie
Ay . questio que Iuris / wold he crye
He was a Ientyl harlad / and a kynde
A bettir felawe / shuld men nat fynde
He wold suffre / for a quart of wyn
A good felawe / to haue his concubyn
A twelve moneth / and excuse him at the fulle
Wel preuylych a fynch / cowde he pulle
And if he fond owher / any good felawe
He wold techyn him / to haue noon awe
In suche caas / of tharchedekyns curse
But if manys sowle / were in his purs
For in his purs / he shuld punched be
Purs is the thth Archedekyns helle seid he
Of cursyng awht / eủery man drede /
